name: PROJECT MONSTER
desc:
Project Monster Multiplayer is a game in which you will have to work as a team.

There are 2 game modes:
🤠You are a single player: You will play as a team
👹You are the monster: You must kill the other players

There are 3 game modes:
🎁First Mode: You will have to collect 25 boxes and then escape on the train.
🔫Second Mode: You will have to collect boxes and then throw them at the monster to kill it
💊Third Mode: You will have to collect things to deactivate the machine that wants to revive the monster

Rewards (Emeralds):
💰Chests with Like and Group Member goals
💸Codes on our Fan Page
💎Reviving a player will give you gems
👑Staying until the end of the game will give you gems
